$comment: Third-party skills and where they come from. NONE is stored in this repository: the 26 that used to sit under vendor/ now live in optional pack repositories, specified by packs/ and attached per Project. This file records what is NOT packaged, plus the multi-agent install behaviour worth knowing about.

orca-cli.reason: DROPPED from the toolkit, on evidence from the tree rather than from a README. Its SKILL.md is a 46-line discovery stub whose entire body resolves an `orca` executable and then asks it for the real guide, so without the binary there is no degraded mode -- there is nothing. No orca, orca-ide or orca-dev was on PATH and ORCA_CLI_COMMAND was unset in the environment where it would most often load. Nothing in this repository depended on it. At 642 description characters it was the second most expensive description of the 27, and it is the only one with no upstream plugin: stablyai/orca ships no .claude-plugin at all.
orca-cli.stillWorksWhere: A machine with Orca installed. That is a local-install concern; link it from an Orca checkout if you want it there.
orca-cli.toReinstate: add a packs/orca.json with the pin above and build it like any other pack

find-skills.reason: Present in ~/.agents/skills but NOT linked into ~/.claude/skills, so it is not available to Claude Code locally either. Vendoring it would add a capability rather than port one. Add a pack spec under packs/ if that changes.

ui-ux-pro-max.reason: A real directory in ~/.claude/skills duplicating what the ui-ux-pro-max plugin ships. Vendoring it would fork a plugin's own content for no gain. LOCAL DELIVERY IS REVIEWED, NOT VERIFIED: profile/plugins.json records installedLocally 2.5.0, which is installation, not skill delivery, and no test here invokes the skill through the plugin. That is the load-bearing half of this decision and it carries no measurement. IN CLOUD, on 2026-09-20, in Anthropic's hosted environment, a fresh session with this plugin declared in .claude/settings.json installed zero plugins (docs/host-integration.md, profile/plugins.json cloudObservation). This field previously said the plugin was declared in .claude/settings.json and installs in cloud; neither half was true by then -- the keys had moved to profile/plugins.json and the measurement had already been taken. Scope: that environment, that date. It is not a claim about cloud sessions generally; profile/plugins.json claimTiers marks the universal version NOT ESTABLISHED. Project settings -> Plugins is the documented route for a cloud project that wants it; that route is DOCUMENTED, NOT MEASURED here.

ecc skills (181).reason: Delivered by the ecc plugin locally, which is why they are not packaged. LOCAL DELIVERY IS REVIEWED, NOT VERIFIED, on the same footing as ui-ux-pro-max above: profile/plugins.json records installedLocally 1.10.0, which is installation rather than skill delivery. IN CLOUD, on 2026-09-20, in Anthropic's hosted environment, ecc@ecc was measured NOT INSTALLED and its marketplace never registered (docs/host-integration.md, profile/plugins.json cloudObservation). This field previously said the plugin is declared in .claude/settings.json; it is not, and the keys are in profile/plugins.json. Scope: that environment, that date, not cloud sessions generally. Project settings -> Plugins is the documented route, DOCUMENTED and not measured here.

multiAgentFanOut.$comment: The skills CLI installs into every detected agent directory, not just Claude Code. Recorded because a reinstall reproduces this fan-out and it explains why identical content exists in seven trees on this machine.
multiAgentFanOut.lockFileNote: Records source and a folder hash but NO commit pin, which is why each pack spec resolves its pin independently.

packs.where: packs/ holds the specifications; the content lives in its own repository
packs.attachment: per Project, never automatic. A Project that attaches neither pays for neither.
packs.delivery: .claude/skills/<name> -> skills/<name> inside the PACK repository. VERIFIED 2026-09-20 in two separate fresh cloud sessions with this repository absent: 13/13 skills discovered per pack, entries resolving, and a representative skill (wrangler, minimalist-ui) invoked through the Skill tool with its body injected from the pack's own .claude/skills base directory. Harness delivery, not filesystem readability.
